sections.Highlights: THIS… is a 2022 Mercedes-AMG G63 4x4², finished in Arabian Grey with a Black and Lime Green interior. The odometer currently displays approximately 2,600 miles. The attached Carfax history report shows no accidents or mileage discrepancies in this G63’s brief past. According to the build sheet provided in the gallery, factory equipment includes the AMG Night package, 22-inch AMG wheels, portal axles, 4x4²-specific adjustable suspension, triple locking differentials, a Mercedes Professional roof rack, two-tone leather upholstery, power-adjustable heated and ventilated front seats, a Burmester surround sound system, 3-zone automatic climate control, and more as listed below. The selling dealer reports no modifications. Mercedes brought back the G-Class 4x4² for 2022, only this time instead of a G550, the portal-axle-rocking off-road brute used a G63 AMG as the starting point. Armed with a more powerful twin-turbo V8, the G63 4x4² was also the first vehicle to combine portal axles with an independent front suspension. The result was much better handling on and off the road, with a small penalty of less ground clearance than its predecessor. But the G63 AMG 4x4² doubles down with greater levels of wheel articulation, a 55 percent increase in rigidity, and being lighter by 288 lbs. Power comes from an M177 4.0-liter twin-turbocharged V8, rated at 577 horsepower and 627 lb-ft of torque. Output is sent to all four wheels via a 9-speed automatic transmission and a 2-speed transfer case.
